Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 18-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Cyber Law and Ethics [IT_4003]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Identify an ethical dilemma in technology and illustrate with a simple example.                          (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Model how cultural perspectives can shape or influence ethical judgments in cyberspace.                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Analyze how ethical theories guide moral reasoning in digital contexts, with specific reference to       (5)  
  online privacy or data sharing.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Identify intellectual property in the digital world and give one relevant example.                       (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Demonstrate how adherence to professional codes of conduct supports ethical practice in                  (3)  
  computing professions.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Examine the ethical and legal challenges associated with cybercrime and identity theft.                  (5)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Model social networking ethics and give an example of responsible behavior on social media.              (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Illustrate the challenges of maintaining authenticity in virtual identities and suggest ways to uphold   (3)  
  ethical standards online.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Analyze the ethical concerns arising from emerging technologies such as blockchain or genetic            (5)  
  data storage.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  Page #1

4)                        Identify who certifying authorities are under Indian cyber law and explain their key responsibilities.    (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                             Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Analyze any two cyber offences, explaining how they impact individuals or organizations.                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Evaluate how Indian cyber regulations safeguard users from data misuse. Support your answer               (5)  
  with an example.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
5)                        Identify phishing and describe how it operates in a real-world cyber context.                             (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                             Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Distinguish between the exclusive rights of a patent holder and the rights available to the public        (3)  
  under intellectual property law.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Evaluate the effectiveness of copyright protection for digital works such as software, films, and e-      (5)  
  books in the modern digital environment.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"
